blockHash.description: Hash of the execution layer block the state of `slot` holds. Like `blockNumber`, it can be the same as in the snapshot before it since the Glamsterdam fork (EIP-7732).

blockNumber.description: Number of the execution layer block the state of `slot` holds. Since the Glamsterdam fork (EIP-7732) it can be the same as in the snapshot before it, because a slot does not always add an execution layer block: that happens at the first slot of the fork, and every time a builder does not reveal its payload in time. Tell snapshots apart by `slot`, which always moves forward.

payloadSlot.description: Slot whose execution payload `blockNumber`, `blockHash` and `timestamp` describe. Not set before the Glamsterdam fork (EIP-7732), where a block carries its own payload and the payload slot is always `slot` itself. Since the fork it is normally the parent slot, and it goes further back when the builder of the parent did not reveal its payload in time, or when slots before `slot` were missed.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the execution layer block. Since the Glamsterdam fork (EIP-7732) this is the time of `payloadSlot` and not of `slot`, so it is at least one slot behind. Take the time of `slot` from the slot number itself when that is what is needed.

lastChangedBlockHash.description: Last changed block hash — used to determine that a change has been made to this block

epoch.description: Finalized epoch of the consensus slot the validators were read at.
